get.description: Return a list of all Change Order Statuses.

Per-Page.description: Number of items retrieved per page

Total.description: Total number of items to be retrieved

Link.description: Link headers for the first, prev, next, and last link

id.description: Unique identifier for this company-defined change order status.

name.description: Display name of the custom change order status (e.g. No Charge).

mapped_to_status.description: The built-in system status this custom status maps to for workflow and reporting purposes (e.g. approved, pending, draft).

show_in_select.description: When true, this status is selectable in change order status dropdowns in the UI.

403.description: User does not have permission to access Change Order Statuses.

reason.description: A human-readable code providing additional detail on the cause of the error.

import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

conn.request("GET", "/rest/v1.0/change_order/statuses?company_id=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&per_page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE")

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))
